title: How WeRateDogs Is Fighting A.I. Slop, One Perfect Puppy at a Time
summary: Matt Nelson built an internet empire based on jokes he wrote at 18. Now he is trying to stem the tide of fake dogs taking over dog lovers’ feeds.
